quoting.shell: {x:shell}: as given when it is plain, else shell-quoted like {x:shell-always}. Plain means non-empty, not starting with ~ or #, and free of control characters and of the characters space ! " $ & ' ( ) * ; < > ? [ \ ^ ` | = :. This is coreutils' default file name quoting under LANG=C.UTF-8.
quoting.shell-always: {x:shell-always}: always quoted: 'x'; "x" when it holds ' but none of " $ ` \ !; otherwise 'it'\''s'. Each control character becomes its own $'\t' / $'\n' / $'\r' / $'\NNN' piece between quoted runs.
quoting.locale: {x:locale}: in the UTF-8 locale's curly quotes, ‘x’, as GNU tools quote values (not file names) such as an invalid date or number.
